# `app.graycard.meter.calibration`

A calibration profile for a metering instrument — most importantly a phone acting as a meter, where each camera module and sensor path needs its own correction. Stored in the repo so profiles roam across app installs. A reading references the profile that was applied to it, keeping every value auditable.

- **Source:** `lexicons/app/graycard/meter/calibration.json`
- **Lexicon version:** `1`
- **Definitions:** 1

## `main`
